text: 猿人骚动起来。其中一只手掌朝天指向天空。远处有几个黑点——是飞行生物。它们逐渐变大。
你简直不敢相信自己的眼睛：飞行的甲壳类生物，以触手作为前端。大脚怪放开你，畏缩着尖叫臣服。你转身惊恐逃跑。

en.title: Alone Against the Frost · 487
text: The ape-men stir. One points with his great palm outward against the sky. Out there are several black specks—flying things. They steadily grow larger.
You cannot believe your eyes. Flying crustaceanoids, with tentacles as their forward parts. The sasquatches release you and cower and shriek in submission. You turn and flee in terror.
